notes.title: Bounty Hunting - Demon and Creature Dollar Values
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38612881/7787a90e0969e836320492a952441b8ef873dbe3.png[/img]
Greetings, bounty hunters!

We’ve been working hard to bring more clarity and immersion to your bounty-hunting experience, and today, we’re excited to unveil our brand-new Bounty Board UI!

The Orcs and Outlaw world is filled with deadly creatures—ferocious orcs, nightmarish demons, and other terrifying beasts. As a mythical bounty hunter, it’s your job to take them down for gold, glory, and survival. Our new Bounty Rewards Board UI provides a detailed overview of your targets, making it easier than ever to plan your next hunt.
🔎 Features of the New UI:

✔️ Target List – See a roster of bounty-worthy creatures, from lowly grunts to elite warlords.
✔️ Bounty Values – Each target has a $ reward based on their strength, rarity, and threat level.
✔️ Threat Ratings – Get a quick glance at how dangerous your target is before engaging in combat (TBD)
✔️ Dynamic Updates – Some high-value targets won’t stay in one place for long! Check back often for new bounties.


The rewards system adds more depth to bounty hunting, letting you strategize better and choose your battles wisely. Do you go after a pack of lower-tier orcs for quick gold, or risk it all taking on a high-value demon lord? The choice is yours!

We’re refining the UI visuals, adding more animations, and integrating a "Most Wanted" leaderboard for the deadliest marks in the game. Stay tuned for more updates!

💬 We’d love your feedback! What do you think of the new Bounty Board UI? Drop your thoughts below!

🔥 You will soon be hunting, bounty hunters! 🔥

#GameDev #SteamUpdate #IndieGame #FantasyShooter #Orcs #BountyHunter #UIUpdate #UnrealEngine

notes.title: Gameplay - Dungeon Showdown : Orcs, Demons & Vampires!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=DOZFpdbzZC0;full][/previewyoutube]

An Orcs and Outlaws gameplay video showing a typical dungeon brawl! 

Showing Ava Garrand, the fearless bounty hunter, as she battles her way through hordes of orcs, vicious wolves, and bloodthirsty vampires in this dark, atmospheric level. Armed with just a handgun at this stage in the game,  Ava delves deep into the heart of a secret Orc dungeon, where enemies lurks around every corner. 

In this gameplay segment, witness some of the intense firefights, run-and-gun combat, and melee action as Ava uses her unique skills and arsenal to take down waves of enemies. The dungeon’s eerie atmosphere, filled with shadows and dark magic, sets the perfect stage for an epic showdown.

If you're a fan of fantasy shooters, epic boss battles, and intense gameplay, Orcs and Outlaws is for you! Don’t forget to like, comment, and subscribe for more adventures with Ava Garrand. Let the battle begin!

The game demo will be out soon - we are working on right now, its looking good !

notes.title: New Splash screen
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=PqBR7ShUWNw;full][/previewyoutube]


Greetings, Steamers!

We are thrilled to announce the latest update for Orcs and Outlaws, bringing a brand-new splash screen , incorporating some of the latest Orc and demon characters.
What's New:

1. Atmospheric New Artwork:
Atmosphere is everything in this game - so we created a new splash screen featuring epic, hand-crafted lighting and visual effects. This dynamic visual sets the tone for the thrilling fantasy action that awaits you in the game. With a snapshot of some of the orc outlaws, and a landscape teeming with adventure, hopefully this artwork will give you a flavor of the dark fantasy settings in the world of Orcs and Outlaws.

2. Enhanced Audio Experience:
Alongside the new visual, we’ve integrated a powerful, cinematic soundtrack that will play during the splash screen. Composed to evoke the spirit of adventure and the clash of battle, this audio enhancement is designed to immerse the player in the game world. 

3. Optimized Loading Times:
We’ve also worked behind the scenes to ensure that the transition from splash screen to main menu is smoother and faster. Enjoy a seamless start to your gaming sessions with reduced loading times.

4. Easter Eggs:
Keep an eye out for hidden elements within any of our new screens. We’ve added a few surprises that hint at future updates and expansions. 

Community Spotlight:
We’d like to take this opportunity to thank our community for the continued support and feedback. Your passion drives us to keep improving and expanding the world of Orcs and Outlaws. Don’t forget to share your thoughts on the new splash screen here or online. 
How to Access the Update:

Stay tuned for more exciting updates and adventures in the world of Orcs and Outlaws!

Happy Gaming,
The Orcs and Outlaws Development Team

notes.title: Orcs and Outlaws – Official Beta Trailer
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=AMxzc_S2eWA;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38612881/27557450f56ea141f64aa4a84dcfb0b03cd66c95.png[/img]

Unveiling the Thrilling World of “Orcs and Outlaws": Watch the Official Beta Trailer Now!
Greetings, wish-listers, adventurers, steamers and gamers!

We are excited to share some news that we've been eagerly waiting to unveil. The moment you've all been waiting for has arrived! The first official trailer for our new action-shooter , "Orcs and Outlaws," is here.

Step into the Shoes of a Legendary Bounty Hunter
"Orcs and Outlaws" invites players to step into the boots of our fierce and fearless protagonist, Ava Garand. Delve into the secret world of infernal bounty hunting. Ava is a legendary bounty hunter, skilled in demonic combat and experienced in tracking phantom spirits and demons. Her latest bounty - to uncover the hidden secrets of an ancient Orc army, find its source of power and, and combat malevolent forces that stand in her way.

Our trailer provides a tantalizing glimpse into the immersive world of "Orcs and Outlaws”" From breathtaking fantasy landscapes, dark caves and castles to intense firefights, the trailer showcases the dynamic gameplay and ferocious shootouts that await you. Witness Ava as she navigates treacherous surroundings, engages in high-octane combat, and unlocks cryptic clues to reveal the mysteries of a long-forgotten demonic army.

Key Features Highlighted in the Trailer
    Stunning Visuals: Our team (me) has meticulously crafted a visually stunning dark mystical world, blending atmospheric lighting and effects, along with fantastical elements to create an environment that feels both intimidating and magical.
    Dynamic Combat: Engage in fast-paced, shooting and melee combat with a wide array of weapons and munitions at your disposal. The trailer highlights some of the adrenaline-fueled action sequences that are at the heart of this game.
    Rich Storyline: Follow Ava as she uncovers a gripping story filled with twists, turns, and unexpected revelations. The trailer hints at the deep lore and compelling Orc characters and lore that drive the game's narrative.

The release of the "Orcs and Outlaws" trailer marks just the beginning of an incredible journey. We can't wait for you to experience the thrills, challenges, and discoveries that await in the game. Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm.

Stay adventurous,
Hanz Solo Dev

The demo will be out next month, with the game being published this October.

notes.notes:
One of the dragon enemies you will face in the game. This guy is the biggest and hardest to kill - really tough hide, normal bullets will not penetrate it. You have to be super accurate to take him down. And there is more than one.

They guard the Orc's rune stones, typically located at the end of a map - hard to get to.

notes.title: The Possessed Militia
notes.notes:
A group photo of some of the Possessed Militia.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38612881/852c40c0847f425e92c02eaa2fbffcc3241d3b14.png[/img]

So who are they?

To establish their new reign, the Orcs tribes realised they need the help of man, more specifically the war technology of man. As in their time, paid soldiers still exist and a band of mercenaries were recruited to become the Possessed Militia. Some of the mercenaries were obsessed with the Orc’s dark powers and drank their mutating elixir. They transformed into an army of undead warriors ,still trained in their modern weaponry and extremely difficult to stop.

The Militia act as bodyguards for important Orc bosses and lieutenants. Make sure you are fully equipped before taking them on.

notes.notes:
Can you spot the orc in time?

This is some game dev footage from the Orcs and Outlaws demo , which will be out soon. As you see, it can be pretty hard to spot a green Orcs in a green jungle. Just testing the orc AI and Mia's new assault rifle.

notes.title: Snarls
notes.notes:
Finally getting to add some of the creature enemies to the game. It has been a lot of prep work up to this. Generating the island terrain and sorting out the path-finding and navigation on large uneven areas has not been that easy. 

Snarls will be one of orc type creatures that you will encounter first. They thing with Snarls is that is never just one of them. They hunt and patrols in packs. So may sure you have a good ammo supply before taking them on. Though small, they are fast with a nasty axe so pick your battles with them. 

More enemy previews to come coon

notes.title: The Underground Levels - Video preview
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=QBHF8wRgga4;full][/previewyoutube]

We are almost finished our first underground level and we wanted to show you what it is going to look like. This is just a demo but will give you an idea of what the final production version will look like. The finished version will be a lot darker and it will be difficult to navigate. The island cave network is where most of the heavy-duty creatures hide. You should not spend too long down there. Each cave will have a transit portal – vital for island hopping. 


Enjoy the demo and if you like, please share and like. As always, we are a small team and really appreciate your support.

Thanks!
Hanz SoloDev

notes.title: Finalizing the Game Demo
notes.notes:
The first game demo is in beta and close to release

Sorry for the delay in updating our status on the game but with a small team, everything takes longer than expected. We have the character and animal AI working. Enemies now chase you and better still, shoot at you. We are not sure yet how big the demo will. A key thing with C24 is the relationship between the over-world (island) and underworld (caves/caverns), and the relationship between The Czar and Mia. 

Condition 24 is an action adventure game combining open-world platform gameplay with third person shooting and mayhem ... lots of mayhem and madness... considering the year we are having. Curse you covid!

Remember our massive dev team of 2 is working around the clock to bring you our epic game - we are also very modest and never exaggerate.... never ever 

Lots more updates coming soon. 

The Fierce Developer
